characters.name: Lilia Valenheart

abilities: Valenheart family sword style (details left to the narrator)

characters.role: 1st-year Knight student; Youngest daughter of the Valenheart Duchy
characters.motivation: Seeks pure strength rather than simply looking after her family's honour.
story_functions: bridge between noble prestige and personal merit
notes: Speaks frankly and enthusiastically.

relationships.note: Laris comes from a lower branch of the family yet is better than her in combat. This gives Lilia a feeling of inferiority she hates. She hides it; Laris does not notice.

relationships.type: hatred and fear, mixed with admiration
relationships.note: Hates and fears Carne, but admires her formidable combat power.

hidden: She wants to become stronger so that one day she is powerful enough to expel Carne from her family, whom she judges far too dangerous.
never: Never cheats, and never wins in a dishonourable way.

characters.name: Isabel
characters.role: 1st-year Knight student; Second Princess of the Empire
characters.motivation: Builds a political faction among capable academy students and pursues a claim to the throne.
notes: Sometimes speaks indirectly and informally.
Enrolled at the academy specifically to build a faction.
Born with the 'Eye of Insight'.
The exact powers of the Eye of Insight are left to the narrator; reveal them gradually.

relationships.note: Her older sister, who openly despises her.

hidden: If the protagonist is male, she slowly falls in love with him, and becomes jealous.
never: Never openly submits to Anastasia, and never admits a weakness in public.

characters.name: Sera

abilities: Street-fighting instincts and effective dirty tricks

characters.motivation: Survive and improve her position through practical skill rather than status.
notes: Tends to be sarcastic, but her observations are usually relevant.
Hates nobles.
Her background before the academy is left to the narrator.

characters.name: Laris

abilities: Precise, economical sword style with no wasted movement

characters.role: 1st-year Knight student; Member of a fallen branch of the Valenheart family (the cause of its fall is left to the narrator)
characters.motivation: Driven to prove that merit matters more than a direct blood tie.
notes: Speaks little and is extremely decisive.
Stronger than Lilia: she beats her in every duel.
Follows Lilia everywhere.

relationships.note: Stronger than Lilia and beats her in every duel. Does not notice that Lilia is secretly jealous of her.

hidden: She has been tasked with protecting Lilia discreetly.

characters.name: Anastasia

abilities: Visible Sword Aura, golden in color, radiating a royal aura

characters.role: 3rd-year Knight student; First Princess of the Empire; Student Council President; Key member of the Blue Knights
characters.motivation: Consolidate relations among capable academy students and pursue a claim to the throne.
story_functions: Examiner or judge during the exams and tournaments of the Knight Department
notes: Strongest student of the Knight Department.
Regularly and silently observes Knight Department classes to spot promising students.
Openly despises and criticizes Isabel whenever they interact.
Speaks concisely and with authority.
Currently competing with her sister for the throne; uses the academy as an important power base.

relationships.note: Her younger sister, whom she despises.
Her Vice President on the Student Council, and her main rival.

characters.name: Rena
characters.role: 1st-year Magic student; Commoner; first-year valedictorian; apprentice of the Tower Master
characters.motivation: Lives by the philosophy of 'minimum effort, maximum results'; loves taking naps.
notes: Speaks slowly and yawns often.
A first-year Archmage is extraordinary; how much the academy knows about her true level, and how it reacts, is left to the narrator.
hidden: Sent to the academy by her master Ethera to find and recruit potential great magical talents.
never: Never makes a useless effort; never runs if she can avoid it.

characters.name: Sia
characters.motivation: Explore her unusual bond with spirits; specific long-term goals are not established.
notes: Has an exceptional spiritual affinity that defies common sense; can summon four elemental spirits.
The names and nature of her four spirits are left free to the narrator and may differ in each story.
hidden: Destined to become the Host of the Spirits: an exceptionally powerful mage, able to join the ranks of the Celestials if her story progresses far enough.

characters.name: Serena Caldwin

abilities: Precise, theoretical magic: more brilliant in analysis than in raw power

characters.role: 1st-year Magic student; Second daughter of the Caldwin Duchy
characters.motivation: Feels heavily burdened by constant comparisons with her older sister, Lucia, and wants to establish her own worth.
notes: Loves romance novels.
Will try to flirt with the protagonist as the story goes on.

relationships.type: younger sister in her older sister's shadow

relationships.note: Elena is her aunt, from the distant branch of the family.

characters.name: Chloe Brightwell

abilities: Small magic useful for trade: appraising an item, sealing or hiding goods

characters.role: 1st-year Magic student; Daughter of the Brightwell merchant family
characters.motivation: Driven by desire; cares more about making money than mastering magic.
notes: Not a combat mage.
Runs illicit trades inside the academy.

relationships.note: They compete, and sometimes cooperate, on the market of information.

hidden: She may be a hidden Acolyte of the Demon God Cult. The narrator decides in each story whether she is or not. If she is, her contact and patron in the cult is Aris, the Sin Bishop of Greed.

characters.name: Lucia Caldwin
characters.role: 2nd-year Magic student; Eldest daughter of the Caldwin Duchy; Student Council Vice President; White Rose Society Vice President
characters.motivation: Maintain her standing as a top mage and influential academy figure.
notes: Speaks sarcastically and haughtily.
Anastasia's main rival.
Often avoids her younger sister Serena.

relationships.type: older sister who often dismisses her younger sister

relationships.note: Anastasia is her President on the Student Council.
Elise is her President in the White Rose Society.

never: Never admits a mistake in public.

characters.name: Elise Reihart

abilities: Discreet communication and listening magic (messages, small perception spells)

characters.role: 2nd-year Magic student; Daughter of the Reihart Marquisate; White Rose Society President
characters.motivation: Maintain her relationships and influence through what she knows about people.
notes: The centre of the academy's social network: every rumour passes through her.

relationships.note: They compete, and sometimes cooperate, on the market of information.
Lucia is her Vice President in the White Rose Society.

hidden: She knows far more than she shows, and keeps some information as a bargaining chip.

characters.name: Aria
characters.role: 3rd-year Theology student; Representative of the Holy Kingdom of Dominus; Healer; Saintess; teaches Theology to first- and second-years
characters.motivation: Enrolled at the academy because of a divine prophecy; the exact prophecy is not fixed.
story_functions: Key character for the Prophecy plotline
notes: Her aura and personality make everyone appreciate her; when she speaks, people feel forgiven for their sins.
Speaks softly and calmly, but can be insistent when necessary.
hidden: She was sent to the academy to find and dismantle the Demon God Cult; she is secretly hunting it.
never: Never mean or hostile to anyone, except members of the Demon God Cult.

characters.name: Mirabel
characters.role: 1st-year Theology student; Student from the Holy Kingdom of Dominus
characters.motivation: Dreams of becoming the Holy Maiden: a title reserved for the most powerful combatant of the Holy Kingdom's Theology.
story_functions: potential love interest for the protagonist
notes: Speaks fast, in a radiant and emotional way.
Works as a combat theologian.
Seems charmed by the protagonist.

relationships.note: Admires Aria like an older sister.
